paras: Application: Toyota GR Supra MK5 Part Type: Fuel filter mount (billet clamp kit) Part Number: 20-0752

Hardware for installing a Radium Engineering fuel filter in the MK5 Supra. The upper half of the billet aluminium clamp secures to OEM threaded studs using the provided flange nuts – these studs are on the opposing side of the plastic undertray, just to the left of the transmission. The lower half of the clamp secures the filter using stainless steel bolts.
hl: OEM Stud Mounting: Mounts to OEM threaded studs
Billet Anodised Aluminium Clamps: Upper and lower clamp halves
Stainless Steel Bolts: Secure the filter in the lower clamp
Bosch Pump Compatible: Also suits an external Bosch 0 580 254 044 fuel pump
ft: Radium Engineering Fuel Filter Mount for Toyota GR Supra A90 MK5 2019+
